title: Agents
blurb: Run coding agents side by side and never miss a question.

greet: Agents live in panes here. I will show you how to keep an eye on them.
Hi. Let us start an agent and check on it from elsewhere.
finish: Now you can run agents and still get your own work done.

steps.title: Open the rail
steps.note: Every agent shows up here, with what it is doing.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then b. The rail opens on the right.

steps.title: Start an agent
steps.note: A pretend Claude Code. It runs nowhere but here.
steps.hint: Type claude and press enter. Watch the rail.

web.note: A pretend Claude Code. It never leaves this tab.

steps.title: Go do something else
steps.note: It will ask you something soon. You will know.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then w, then 2. Keep an eye on the rail and the dock.

steps.title: Jump to the question
steps.note: The rail turns orange and the dock rings. ctrl+b j takes you there.
steps.waiting: Wait for the agent to ask. The rail turns orange when it does.
steps.hint: Wait for the orange mark, then ctrl+b, then j.

steps.title: Say yes
steps.note: y approves. The mark turns green when it is done.
steps.hint: Press y, or enter on Yes.

explainer.body: On a real machine agents find each other with tuios list-agents and mail each other. ctrl+b M opens the mail between them.

steps.title: Every agent in one view
steps.note: ctrl+b i opens the agents view. The next track, The agents view, shows what it does.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then i. esc closes it.
